answer: An environmental attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to stream seismic noise from basalt bedrock alongside magnetic telemetry from ferrous conduits. The network flags unverified nodes into a saffron quarantine pool when spatial entropy correlations fail. To forge identities, an adversary must deploy dedicated, geographically dispersed sensor hardware per node. However, this defense excludes purely cloud-hosted agents lacking access to physical infrastructure.
